title: Chúc ngủ ngon, thư viện cũ
about: Round 41, thu-vien ("tôi thấy không hay, bạn hãy sáng tác theo ý của bạn và dùng bộ sound phù hợp"), Nocturnes for an Old Library, Goodnight, Old Library: good night to the old library, C minor at 48 bpm: a lullaby in half notes (Eb-G, Ab-C), the left hand rocking in the middle (texture flow); the middle in Eb major; the last chord C major. The piano alone, on thu-vien (ke-chuyen-gan's grand, hall and echo, with nothing heavy: no Rhodes, the lows not lifted, the left hand from C3 with no octave); a singing line in periods, a question and an answer, each return varied; soft, a gentle swell in the middle, no climax. An original tune.
